jobs.title: VP of Systems Engineering - Federal
jobs.description:
VAST Data is building the data platform for the AI era. The VAST Data Platform brings together storage, database, compute, and data services into a unified architecture designed to power the world’s most demanding AI, analytics, and data-intensive environments.

We’re looking for a Vice President of Systems Engineering – Federal to lead the technical field organization supporting VAST’s U.S. Federal business.

The Role

The VP of Systems Engineering – Federal is a second-line leadership role responsible for building, leading, and scaling the Systems Engineering organization supporting VAST’s Federal business.

This leader will manage SE leaders and their teams across the Federal organization, establish the technical strategy for the business, and partner closely with Federal Sales leadership to drive growth across defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies.

This is not simply a people-management position.

We’re looking for a technical and commercial leader who can operate comfortably from the executive level down to the architecture—someone capable of advising senior government technology leaders, shaping complex AI and data infrastructure strategies, developing exceptional SE leaders, and stepping into the most technically demanding opportunities when needed.

What You’ll Do

Lead the Federal Systems Engineering organization, managing and developing first-line SE leaders and their teams across the U.S. Federal business.
Build the organizational structure, leadership bench, technical capabilities, and operating model required to scale VAST’s Federal business.
Partner with Federal Sales leadership to define account strategy, prioritize opportunities, penetrate strategic agencies, and win significant new programs.
Establish a consistently high bar for technical discovery, solution architecture, competitive positioning, POCs, executive engagement, and technical deal execution.
Develop SE managers into exceptional leaders who can recruit, coach, challenge, and elevate their teams—not simply administer them.
Remain actively engaged in VAST’s largest and most strategic Federal opportunities, particularly where executive alignment, complex architecture, or competitive differentiation is critical.
Build trusted relationships with senior government technology leaders, architects, program leaders, mission partners, and the broader Federal technology ecosystem.
Translate complex mission and business requirements into full-stack architectures spanning compute, networking, storage, data platforms, cloud, and AI infrastructure.
Ensure the SE organization can articulate not only how VAST works, but why its architecture matters to a customer's mission and technology strategy.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, CTO Office, Support, Alliances, and Sales to bring Federal requirements into VAST and VAST innovation into the Federal market.
Develop repeatable technical sales motions that increase the organization's ability to win and scale.
Create a culture of accountability, intellectual curiosity, technical excellence, customer obsession, and continuous development across the Federal SE organization.
Significant leadership experience within Systems Engineering, Solutions Engineering, technical pre-sales, or field architecture organizations supporting the U.S. Federal market.
Proven experience as a second-line leader, with responsibility for developing managers as well as building and scaling larger technical organizations.
Demonstrated success supporting complex Federal technology sales across DoD, Intelligence Community, and/or Federal Civilian agencies.
A track record of helping technical organizations create and win net-new business, rather than primarily supporting an established customer base.
Experience building organizations in high-growth or rapidly changing environments, including recruiting exceptional talent, establishing operating rhythms, and raising the performance bar.
Deep full-stack technical credibility across modern data and AI infrastructure: strong understanding of distributed storage and data architectures; file and object protocols including NFS, SMB, and S3; NVMe/NVMe-oF; high-performance networking including Ethernet, RDMA/RoCE, and InfiniBand; Linux; Kubernetes and containers; cloud platforms; and modern GPU infrastructure including NVIDIA and AMD. - Strong understanding of the modern data and AI ecosystem, including technologies such as Spark, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Trino, Kafka, GPU infrastructure, AI training and inference architectures, and the infrastructure required to operate these environments at scale. - Ability to reason across the entire technology stack—compute, networking, storage, data platforms, and AI infrastructure—and challenge senior SEs and architects on solution design, performance, scalability, and tradeoffs.
Strong executive presence with the ability to move seamlessly between deeply technical architecture conversations and strategic discussions with senior government and technology executives.
Demonstrated ability to translate architectural differentiation into mission impact, business value, competitive advantage, and measurable customer outcomes.
Strong understanding of the Federal partner ecosystem and how OEMs, integrators, channel partners, technology alliances, and other strategic partners influence Federal opportunities.
Ability to travel as required to support customers, partners, and the Federal organization.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Business Development, T1 CSP Customers - DC GPU
jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

The Team

AMD's Data Center GPU organization is transforming the industry with our AI based Graphic Processors. Our primary objective is to design exceptional products that drive the evolution of computing experiences, serving as the cornerstone for enterprise Data Centers, (AI) Artificial Intelligence, HPC and Embedded systems. If this resonates with you, come and joining our Data Center GPU organization where we are building amazing AI powered products with amazing people.

The Role

AMD is seeking an experienced professional for its Tier 1 CSP Business Group (DC GPU CBG), focused on driving our business success with North America cloud service providers. The role requires deep engagement with engineering, sales, and customer success teams to drive North America CSP business growth and ensure successful deployment of AMD technologies in AI and cloud environments. This role will report directly to a CVP in AMD DC GPU BU and will be based in U.S.

THE PERSON:

This is a high-impact role with direct influence over AMD’s strategic engagements with North America cloud providers and AI innovators. Candidates should bring a mix of technical proficiency, strategic thinking, operational excellence, and strong cross-functional communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

Drive the strategy and playbook for AMD’s engagement with North America cloud customers through deep understanding of our customer needs, and proven ability to synthesize a comprehensive overall hardware + software solution.
Outline and operationalize strategic business targets aligned with corporate and BU-level goals
Execute to annual objectives as measured by design wins, revenue and gross margin
Engage with system hardware architects, software engineers, and thought leaders at customers and ensure efficient collaboration with AMD engineering and software teams
Lead technical and business-related follow-ups as AMD’s key point of contact
Build partnerships with CSP’s internal teams and their customers
Develop training materials and demand-generation content
Analyze industry trends, especially CSP performance in AI
Serve as first line of resolve technical and quality issues with North America CSPs
Forecast and align customer-specific revenue plans with AMD Sales teams
Collaborate extensively with AMD engineering, product, quality, and business planning teams, in some cases across BUs

Preferred Experience

Expertise in GPUs and acceleration in AI/cloud
Ability to assess technical and business trade-offs for ROI
History of executive level interactions in the business and technical domains
Extensive experience in business development or product management in the semiconductor industry
Proven work experience with managing quarterly forecasts, pricing, customer portfolio/roadmaps alignment, driving design wins, sell-in and sell-out enablement and crafting overall account strategies
Possess an understanding of where technology is heading and how to use it to make an impact on driving customer interest
Have solid experience and thorough understanding of datacenter, MDC and channel business models
Have a strong passion for winning!
Demonstrated leadership capabilities along with a strong collaborative style
Ability to lead, influence and project manage global cross functional teams
Demonstrated communication skills, both written and verbal, including presenting to different audiences - customers, media, analysts, technical experts and senior executives
Possess a network of industry relationships with potential partners, competitors, customers and thought leaders
Strategic thinker with a high level of integrity and strong work ethic
Able to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment

Academic Credentials

BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering

MBA preferred

LOCATION:

Santa Clara CA or Austin TX (Might consider other western locations)

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance.

AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available here.

jobs.title: Head of AEO & SEO
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Growth Marketing is a team of performance-driven marketers and channel specialists. We partner closely with growth product, regional and demand marketing, and sales to drive revenue through self-serve and sales motions. The SEO & AEO function specifically drives organic discovery ensuring Stripe is found, cited, and recommended when developers, founders, and finance leaders are searching for or asking about payments, financial infrastructure, and related topics.

What you’ll do

This role owns one of the most strategically important and evolving acquisition channels at Stripe. Organic search is already one of our largest and most efficient growth channels and the emergence of AI-powered answer engines represents a once-in-a-generation shift in how businesses discover software. The role requires someone who can operate at the intersection of content, product, engineering, and data and who can credibly engage with Stripe's executive team on the strategic importance of organic visibility. This is a rare opportunity to define what AEO means for a company like Stripe and to build the playbook that others will follow.

Responsibilities

Own the organic growth strategy end-to-end across SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), including technical optimizations, content strategy, on-site experience, and visibility in general purpose assistants (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.) and coding assistants (e.g. Claude, Codex, etc.)
Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing team of SEO and AEO specialists, fostering a culture of experimentation, operational excellence, and continuous learning
Drive measurable improvements in organic visibility, rankings, citations, traffic, signups, sales inbound and downstream activations across both AEO and SEO
Drive measurable improvements in how well AI tools are able to understand how Stripe’s products work and how to properly integrate them
Partner cross-functionally with product, engineering, content, growth, data science, and marketing to embed SEO/AEO best practices across Stripe's web properties, documentation, and product surfaces
Build and evolve the measurement framework for SEO and AEO: develop attribution models, define leading/lagging indicators, and quantify the revenue impact of organic channels
Own strategic roadmap for AEO: establish Stripe's point of view on how AI-generated answers reshape discovery, and position Stripe to win
Drive improvements across content quality, website architecture, and structured data to maximize discoverability
Represent organic growth performance and strategy across Stripe: translating complex technical SEO/AEO concepts into clear business impact narratives

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

10+ years of experience in SEO, with at least 3 years leading a team and 2+ years at a senior/leadership level engaging with executives
Demonstrated expertise in both technical SEO and content strategy, with a track record of driving significant organic growth at scale
Deep understanding of how AI-powered search and answer engines work (LLM-based retrieval, citation behavior, entity recognition) and a clear point of view on how to optimize for them
Ability to drive improvements across multiple levers: content, website architecture, product surfaces, structured data, measurement, and cross-functional influence
Strong analytical foundation: comfortable with data, attribution challenges, and building measurement frameworks that quantify the business impact of organic channels
Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to executive audiences and build strategic alignment around organic growth investment
Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, product, content, and data science teams to implement SEO/AEO improvements at scale
Track record of building, developing, and retaining high-performing teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with developer-focused or technical B2B products where documentation, API references, and technical content are significant organic surfaces
Background in international SEO strategy, including managing organic growth across multiple markets and languages
Experience building programmatic or product-led SEO at scale (e.g., template pages, user-generated content, dynamic landing pages)
Demonstrated early-mover advantage in AEO evidence of monitoring, optimizing for, or measuring visibility in AI-generated answers
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, metrics-driven culture where you must build the case for investment through data and strategic narrative

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $210,200 - $315,200. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Please find our California applicant personal information notice here.

The application window will remain open for 100 days after the Job Post is published. However, this opportunity will remain open based on the needs of the business, which may cause the application window to close before or after the 100-day mark.

The SEO & AEO function specifically drives organic discovery ensuring Stripe is found, cited, and recommended when developers, founders, and finance leaders are searching for or asking about payments, financial infrastructure, and related topics.

What you’ll do

This role owns one of the most strategically important and evolving acquisition channels at Stripe. Organic search is already one of our largest and most efficient growth channels and the emergence of AI-powered answer engines represents a once-in-a-generation shift in how businesses discover software. The role requires someone who can operate at the intersection of content, product, engineering, and data and who can credibly engage with Stripe's executive team on the strategic importance of organic visibility. This is a rare opportunity to define what AEO means for a company like Stripe and to build the playbook that others will follow.

Responsibilities

Own the organic growth strategy end-to-end across SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), including technical optimizations, content strategy, on-site experience, and visibility in general purpose assistants (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.) and coding assistants (e.g. Claude, Codex, etc.)
Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing team of SEO and AEO specialists, fostering a culture of experimentation, operational excellence, and continuous learning
Drive measurable improvements in organic visibility, rankings, citations, traffic, signups, sales inbound and downstream activations across both AEO and SEO
Drive measurable improvements in how well AI tools are able to understand how Stripe’s products work and how to properly integrate them
Partner cross-functionally with product, engineering, content, growth, data science, and marketing to embed SEO/AEO best practices across Stripe's web properties, documentation, and product surfaces
Build and evolve the measurement framework for SEO and AEO: develop attribution models, define leading/lagging indicators, and quantify the revenue impact of organic channels
Own strategic roadmap for AEO: establish Stripe's point of view on how AI-generated answers reshape discovery, and position Stripe to win
Drive improvements across content quality, website architecture, and structured data to maximize discoverability
Represent organic growth performance and strategy across Stripe: translating complex technical SEO/AEO concepts into clear business impact narratives

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

10+ years of experience in SEO, with at least 3 years leading a team and 2+ years at a senior/leadership level engaging with executives
Demonstrated expertise in both technical SEO and content strategy, with a track record of driving significant organic growth at scale
Deep understanding of how AI-powered search and answer engines work (LLM-based retrieval, citation behavior, entity recognition) and a clear point of view on how to optimize for them
Ability to drive improvements across multiple levers: content, website architecture, product surfaces, structured data, measurement, and cross-functional influence
Strong analytical foundation: comfortable with data, attribution challenges, and building measurement frameworks that quantify the business impact of organic channels
Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to executive audiences and build strategic alignment around organic growth investment
Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, product, content, and data science teams to implement SEO/AEO improvements at scale
Track record of building, developing, and retaining high-performing teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with developer-focused or technical B2B products where documentation, API references, and technical content are significant organic surfaces
Background in international SEO strategy, including managing organic growth across multiple markets and languages
Experience building programmatic or product-led SEO at scale (e.g., template pages, user-generated content, dynamic landing pages)
Demonstrated early-mover advantage in AEO evidence of monitoring, optimizing for, or measuring visibility in AI-generated answers
Comfort operating in a fast-paced, metrics-driven culture where you must build the case for investment through data and strategic narrative

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $210,200 - $315,200. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

The application window will remain open for 100 days after the Job Post is published. However, this opportunity will remain open based on the needs of the business, which may cause the application window to close before or after the 100-day mark.
